translation: Horse's puffball (馬屁勃) is commonly called dog-head ash (狗頭灰); that produced outside the pass is best. <ins>Ding Tong San (定痛散)</ins> Treats all injuries from beating and wind, settles pain, reduces swelling, relaxes sinews, and harmonizes the collaterals. Chinese angelica (當歸), chuanxiong (川芎), white peony (白芍), cassia bark (官桂, each one qian), san nai (三奈, three qian), musk (麝香, three fen), safflower (紅花, five qian), purple clove root (紫丁香根, five qian), cimicifuga (升麻, one qian), saposhnikovia (防風, one qian). Grind all together into a fine powder, mix with the pounded juice of old scallion and apply to the affected area, then use the ironing method.
